cities.name: Los Angeles
cities.market_notes: LA is one of the deepest life company CRE markets nationally. Life insurers have been active here for decades across multifamily, industrial, NNN, and Class A office. The market's high barriers to entry, strong in-migration, and institutional-quality asset base match life company underwriting preferences. Rent stabilization (RSO) applies to pre-1978 multifamily, limiting life company appetite for older value-add stock but supporting strong demand for newer Class A.

Multifamily outside rent-stabilized stock, industrial in the outer boroughs, and credit-tenant NNN remain strong life company targets. High land values support strong collateral coverage even at conservative LTVs. NYC's HSTPA rent stabilization rules restrict life company appetite for pre-1974 rent-stabilized multifamily.
